clusters.pick_reason: #1996 implements a full media-type parser (acceptsMediaType helper) that splits the Accept header on commas, strips whitespace/case, honors q=0 exclusion per RFC 7231, and supports type/subtype wildcard matching. #2046 replaces the strict AND check with a simpler substring check (acceptHeader?.includes('application/json')), which does not account for q-value=0 (a client sending 'application/json;q=0' would be incorrectly accepted) or media-type parameters/wildcards. #1996's approach handles more of the Accept-header edge cases that the two PRs are both trying to fix.

clusters.pick_reason: #2214 only touches the cosmetic slash-stripping (in buildWellKnownPath and buildDiscoveryUrls) and is labeled a 'chore'; it does not update shouldAttemptFallback(), which still checks `pathname === '/'` for the root sentinel. Since the new regex strip also turns a bare '/' into '', #2214 alone breaks that root check and causes a redundant fallback request on root-like URLs. #2215 fixes the same trailing-slash bug in buildWellKnownPath via a shared normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper AND updates shouldAttemptFallback() to check for '' instead of '/', so root detection stays consistent — it's filed as a 'fix' because it addresses the actual behavioral regression, not just cosmetic double-slash avoidance.
